featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this Sports bar in virar. Good for friends get together to enjoy your favourite sports,  also as the name goes they have sports decor.

Live singing and they also have Dj night on some specific days!

featured_reviews.name: vikas yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
The newly opened sports themed bar located in Virar has got everything pn the board perfect. The ambience is amazing with sports setup and a big screen with projector so that you don't miss out on any live matches. The weekend is packed with Live music and Dj nights so do confirm before you visit.
Now coming to the drinks, the bar menu is just amazing be it the cocktails Or Mocktails. I tried Pina colada (4.9/5) and Virgin mojito (4.5/5)
In food menu there are lot of options that you can opt for. I tried BBQ Chicken wings (4.9/5), Chicken loaded nachos (5/5) and Pesto chicken pasta (4.8/5).
Don't miss out on this one you can relax your weekend with a drink and munchies.
The overall experience dining here was amazing be it the staff or management, music, ambience I just loved it.

Had so much fun with there’s live music session and there’s vibe is also so vibrant and attractive with there’s sports theme decor.

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Giri
featured_reviews.review_text:

I tried mushroom cigar roll,
white sauce pasta, nachos, french fries, Virgin Cosmopolitan mocktail.
